tools.name: list_parks
tools.description: List the U.S. national parks and entrances ParkReady covers this week (official NPS/NWS facts compiled weekly by GOES Health).

tools.name: get_park_conditions
tools.description: This week's official conditions for a covered U.S. national park (and optionally one entrance): open/closed status, NPS alerts and closures, NWS forecast snapshot, seasonal risks, prep checklist, with source URLs. Use the name ('Zion'), NPS code ('zion', 'yose') or slug.

tools.name: list_heat_guides
tools.description: List HeatReady city × industry heat-illness prevention guides for outdoor workers and supervisors. Optional city / industry filters.

tools.name: get_heat_guide
tools.description: Full HeatReady guide by slug (from list_heat_guides): checklist, heat triggers, local regulatory note, official OSHA/NIOSH sources, and the Markdown text.

tools.name: get_goes_app_info
tools.description: What the GOES Outdoor Health & Safety app does offline, its pricing model, and iOS / Android download links.

tools.name: get_goes_api_plans
tools.description: GOES Health Intelligence API plans, including self-serve checkout (free key, credit packs, Builder Payment Links) and sales plans read live from goes.health/goes-pricing.html.
